Package com.avpkit.mediatool.event

Class ARawMediaMixin

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.avpkit.mediatool.event.AEventMixin
      • com.avpkit.mediatool.event.AStreamMixin
        • com.avpkit.mediatool.event.ARawMediaMixin
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    AudioSamplesEvent, VideoPictureEvent
    public abstract class ARawMediaMixin
extends AStreamMixin
    An abstract implementation of IRawMediaEvent, but does not declare IRawMediaEvent.
    Author:
    aclarke

    • Constructor Detail

      • ARawMediaMixin

        public ARawMediaMixin​(IMediaGenerator source,
                      IMediaData picture,
                      java.lang.Object image,
                      long timeStamp,
                      java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit timeUnit,
                      java.lang.Integer streamIndex)
        Create an ARawMediaMixin.
        Parameters:
        source - the source
        picture - a picture
        image - an image
        timeStamp - a time stamp value. If image is null this value is ignored.
        timeUnit - a time unit for timeStamp. If image is null this value is ignored.
        streamIndex - the stream index this media is associated with or null if none.
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if both picture and image are null.
